html:
Jewelry Appraisal Lead Generation

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers who need customers looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first three leads are free, and each accepted lead costs $40, with an optional valuation widget available for $29 per month.

How the Service Works

CaratBase captures intent‑driven inquiries from people actively searching for jewelry appraisal services in your metro area. After a quick verification step, the lead’s contact information is sent directly to you, so you can follow up while the prospect is still interested. Because the leads are local, you can schedule in‑person appraisals or arrange secure shipping for items that need to be evaluated off‑site.

What You Receive

  • Verified, local prospects – only people who have expressed a clear need for an appraisal or gold‑sale service.
  • No upfront account setup – you start receiving leads as soon as you claim the free offer.
  • U.S.‑focused coverage – initially launched in Atlanta and expanding to additional metros, ensuring geographic relevance.
  • Optional valuation widget – embed a simple appraisal request form on your website for $29 per month, turning site traffic into qualified leads automatically.

Pricing Made Simple

  • First 3 leads: free, so you can test the quality without any risk.
  • Subsequent leads: $40 per accepted lead, billed only when you confirm the prospect is a good fit.
  • Valuation widget (optional): $29 per month, adding a self‑service capture tool to your site.

Why Choose CaratBase

Independent jewelers and appraisers often rely on generic advertising or word‑of‑mouth referrals, which can be unpredictable and time‑consuming. CaratBase removes the guesswork by delivering leads that have already indicated a desire for an appraisal. This focused approach lets you allocate your time to high‑value activities—evaluating pieces, closing sales, and building client relationships—rather than chasing cold inquiries.

Getting Started Is Easy

  1. Visit the lead‑generation page and claim your three free leads.
  2. Provide basic contact details so CaratBase can route the leads to you.
  3. Start receiving verified prospects within minutes of each inquiry.
  4. Add the valuation widget to your website if you want a continuous flow of leads from organic traffic.

FAQ

Does CaratBase cover jewelry appraisal lead generation? Yes. CaratBase specializes in delivering verified leads from people actively seeking jewelry appraisals, gold sales, or engagement ring purchases.

What is the cost after the free leads? Each accepted lead costs $40. The optional website valuation widget is priced at $29 per month.

Can I use CaratBase outside of Atlanta? CaratBase launched in Atlanta and is expanding to additional metropolitan areas, so you can expect local coverage as the service grows into new markets.

Next Step

Ready to fill your appointment book with qualified appraisal requests? Visit CaratBase – Jewelry Appraisal Lead Generation and claim your three free leads today.
